checks: anonymous and unauthorized roles cannot trace recalls; an untracked product cannot masquerade as a lot
recall creation is versioned and idempotent without inventing a physical movement
preparation is traceable without double-counting the depot custody
foreign workspace cannot inspect or mutate another recall
new allocation, reserved preparation and recount all fail with LOT_RECALLED
merchant and assigned driver receive scoped versioned notices; acknowledgements never count as physical recovery
depot recovery requires staff, cannot consume reserved units and unresolved depot stock blocks closure
depot recovery moves exactly five existing units into quarantine, with replay and stale-write protection
reserved units become recoverable only after the real reservation is released
recall quarantine cannot be released through ordinary lot quality controls
outbound recovery requires an exact physically received RETURN lot; linking and replay add no stock
only ADMIN can record a reasoned residual outbound exception; it never becomes recovered stock
closure follows reconciled depot custody and documented outbound residuals
CLOSED records retain permanent batch safety blocks
recalled reserved goods cannot depart, complete remaining scans or be falsely recovered
explicit recall cancellation is ADMIN-only, versioned and idempotent; it releases only the actual reservation
canceling a paid recalled preparation voids the contract while preserving the recorded payment and refund due
recall cancellation detaches the unpicked route stop and invalidates its old loading QR
partially scanned recall cancellation releases the remaining reservation without fabricating a physical movement
prepared recalled stock can close only after explicit cancellation and separate complete physical isolation
historical untracked shipments remain unknown rather than being assigned the newly counted batch
unknown scope needs an explicit closure reason and remains visible after closure
scope: Actual API mutations and fictional payment records in isolated demo workspaces; no database edits, external messages or real payments.
